-- Kontrol sementara T05/T06; HUD dan siklus pengantaran berada di T07/T08.
local CAS = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("PaketKilat")
local C = require(RS.Shared.Config)
local state = {status = "Idle"}
local function request(action, inputState)
	if inputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then RS.Remotes.ActionRequest:FireServer(action, state.orderId) end
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end
RS.Remotes.StateChanged.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(snapshot, code)
	state = snapshot
	CAS:UnbindAction("PKDrop")
	CAS:UnbindAction("PKRecover")
	if state.status == "Carrying" then
		CAS:BindAction("PKDrop", function(_, s) return request("Drop", s) end, true, Enum.KeyCode.Q)
		CAS:SetTitle("PKDrop", C.Labels.Drop)
		CAS:SetPosition("PKDrop", UDim2.fromScale(0.62, 0.6))
	elseif state.status == "Dropped" then
		CAS:BindAction("PKRecover", function(_, s) return request("Recover", s) end, true, Enum.KeyCode.R)
		CAS:SetTitle("PKRecover", C.Labels.Recover)
		CAS:SetPosition("PKRecover", UDim2.fromScale(0.62, 0.6))
	end
	print("[PaketKilat]", code, state.status, state.condition or "")
end)
RS.Remotes.ActionRequest:FireServer("Sync")

-- Semua parameter gameplay tahap pertama. Tidak memerlukan layanan daring.
return table.freeze({
	ActionDistance = 12,
	RequestCooldown = 0.2,
	RecoveryCooldown = 5,
	InitialCondition = 100,
	ImpactDamage = 10,
	DamageCooldown = 1,
	RecoveryPenalty = 20,
	RecoveryPlayerOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0),
	ImpactSpeed = 55,
	ContactMargin = 0.8,
	PhysicsSampleInterval = 1 / 30,
	PackageSize = Vector3.new(2.5, 2, 2),
	CarryOffset = CFrame.new(0, 0, -2.5),
	DropOffset = CFrame.new(0, 0, -4),
	BoundsMin = Vector3.new(-24, -14, -55),
	BoundsMax = Vector3.new(124, 96, 24),
	DestinationId = "Rumah01",
	DestinationName = "Rumah Bu Sari",
	PackageType = "Biasa",
	PromptHoldDuration = 0.15,
	Labels = table.freeze({
		Start = "Ambil pesanan", Pickup = "Ambil ulang", Drop = "Lepas", Recover = "Pulihkan",
	}),
})

-- State otoritatif server. Semua transisi sinkron tanpa yield.
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Delivery = { orders = {}, requests = {} }
local C, P, W, emit
function Delivery.Init(config, packages, world, publish)
	C, P, W, emit = config, packages, world, publish
end
local function root(player)
	local char = player.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return hum and hum.Health > 0 and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil
end
local function near(player, point)
	local r = root(player)
	return r ~= nil and (r.Position - point).Magnitude <= C.ActionDistance
end
function Delivery.Snapshot(player)
	local o = Delivery.orders[player.UserId]
	if not o then return { status = "Idle" } end
	return {
		orderId = o.orderId, ownerUserId = o.ownerUserId, packageType = o.packageType,
		destinationId = o.destinationId, destinationName = C.DestinationName, status = o.status,
		condition = o.condition, startedAt = o.startedAt, rewardProcessed = o.rewardProcessed,
		completionLocked = o.completionLocked, recoveryCount = o.recoveryCount,
		lastRecoveryAt = o.lastRecoveryAt, outOfBounds = o.outOfBounds,
	}
end
function Delivery.Publish(player, code)
	local o = Delivery.orders[player.UserId]
	if o then P.Update(o) end
	emit(player, Delivery.Snapshot(player), code)
end
function Delivery.Handle(player, action, orderId)
	if type(action) ~= "string" or #action > 16 or (orderId ~= nil and (type(orderId) ~= "string" or #orderId > 64)) then
		return false, "InvalidArguments"
	end
	local allowed = { Start = true, Pickup = true, Drop = true, Recover = true, Sync = true }
	if not allowed[action] then return false, "UnknownAction" end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (Delivery.requests[player.UserId] or -math.huge) < C.RequestCooldown then return false, "RateLimited" end
	Delivery.requests[player.UserId] = now
	if action == "Sync" then Delivery.Publish(player, "Sync"); return true, "Sync" end
	if not root(player) then return false, "NotAlive" end
	local o = Delivery.orders[player.UserId]
	if action == "Start" then
		if o then return false, "OrderActive" end
		if not near(player, W.Map.Depot.PickupPoint.Position) then return false, "TooFar" end
		o = {
			orderId = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false), ownerUserId = player.UserId,
			packageType = C.PackageType, destinationId = C.DestinationId, status = "Carrying",
			condition = C.InitialCondition, startedAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow(),
			rewardProcessed = false, completionLocked = false, recoveryCount = 0,
			lastRecoveryAt = -1, lastRecoveryClock = -math.huge, lastDamageAt = -math.huge,
			outOfBounds = false, player = player,
		}
		Delivery.orders[player.UserId] = o
		P.Create(o)
		P.Carry(o, root(player))
	else
		if not o or o.ownerUserId ~= player.UserId or o.orderId ~= orderId then return false, "NotOwnerOrStale" end
		if o.completionLocked then return false, "CompletionLocked" end
		if action == "Pickup" then
			if o.status ~= "Dropped" then return false, "InvalidState" end
			if o.outOfBounds or not near(player, o.package.Position) then return false, "TooFar" end
			o.status = "Carrying"
			P.Carry(o, root(player))
		elseif action == "Drop" then
			if o.status ~= "Carrying" then return false, "InvalidState" end
			o.status = "Dropped"
			P.Drop(o, root(player))
		elseif action == "Recover" then
			if o.status ~= "Dropped" then return false, "InvalidState" end
			if now - o.lastRecoveryClock < C.RecoveryCooldown then return false, "RecoveryCooldown" end
			o.lastRecoveryClock, o.lastRecoveryAt = now, workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
			o.recoveryCount += 1
			o.condition = math.clamp(o.condition - C.RecoveryPenalty, 0, C.InitialCondition)
			o.outOfBounds = false
			P.Recover(o)
			local r = root(player)
			local relative = r.Position - W.Map.DepotPad.Position
			local lo, hi = C.BoundsMin, C.BoundsMax
			if relative.Y < 0 or relative.X < lo.X or relative.X > hi.X or relative.Z < lo.Z or relative.Z > hi.Z or relative.Y > hi.Y then
				player.Character:PivotTo(W.Map.PrototypeSpawn.CFrame + C.RecoveryPlayerOffset)
				r.AssemblyLinearVelocity, r.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
			end
		end
	end
	Delivery.Publish(player, action)
	return true, action
end
function Delivery.Impact(o)
	if Delivery.orders[o.ownerUserId] ~= o or o.completionLocked or o.outOfBounds then return false end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - o.lastDamageAt < C.DamageCooldown then return false end
	if o.status ~= "Carrying" and o.status ~= "Dropped" then return false end
	o.lastDamageAt = now
	o.condition = math.clamp(o.condition - C.ImpactDamage, 0, C.InitialCondition)
	if o.status == "Carrying" then
		o.status = "Dropped"
		P.Drop(o, root(o.player))
	end
	Delivery.Publish(o.player, "Impact")
	return true
end
function Delivery.OutOfBounds(o)
	if o.outOfBounds or Delivery.orders[o.ownerUserId] ~= o then return end
	if o.status == "Carrying" then o.status = "Dropped"; P.Drop(o, root(o.player)) end
	o.outOfBounds = true
	P.Hold(o)
	Delivery.Publish(o.player, "OutOfBounds")
end
-- Kontrak internal untuk T07; tidak dipanggil RemoteEvent tahap pertama.
function Delivery.ValidateCompletion(player, orderId, destinationId)
	local o = Delivery.orders[player.UserId]
	if not o or o.ownerUserId ~= player.UserId or o.orderId ~= orderId then return false, "NotOwnerOrStale" end
	if o.completionLocked or o.rewardProcessed then return false, "CompletionLocked" end
	if o.status ~= "Carrying" then return false, "InvalidState" end
	if destinationId ~= o.destinationId then return false, "WrongDestination" end
	if not near(player, W.Map.Rumah01.DestinationPoint.Position) then return false, "TooFar" end
	return true, "Valid"
end
function Delivery.LockCompletion(player, orderId, destinationId)
	local ok, code = Delivery.ValidateCompletion(player, orderId, destinationId)
	if ok then Delivery.orders[player.UserId].completionLocked = true end
	return ok, code
end
function Delivery.Cancel(player)
	local o = Delivery.orders[player.UserId]
	if o then P.Destroy(o); Delivery.orders[player.UserId] = nil end
	Delivery.requests[player.UserId] = nil
	Delivery.Publish(player, "Cancelled")
end
return Delivery

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local P = {}
local C, W, D, template
function P.Init(config, world, delivery, packageTemplate)
	C, W, D, template = config, world, delivery, packageTemplate
end
function P.Update(o)
	local p = o.package
	if not p then return end
	for _,key in ipairs({"orderId", "ownerUserId", "status", "condition", "outOfBounds"}) do p:SetAttribute(key, o[key]) end
	p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(183, 113 + math.floor(o.condition / 3), 64)
	p.Label.TextLabel.Text = string.format("%s · %s\n%s · %d/100%s", o.player.DisplayName, C.DestinationName, o.status, o.condition, o.outOfBounds and " · R: Pulihkan" or "")
	p.PickupPrompt.Enabled = o.status == "Dropped" and not o.outOfBounds
end
function P.Create(o)
	local p = template:Clone()
	p.Name = o.orderId
	p.CFrame = CFrame.new(W.Map.Depot.PickupPoint.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
	p.Parent = W.ActivePackages
	o.package = p
	o.promptConnection = p.PickupPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		local ok, code = D.Handle(player, "Pickup", o.orderId)
		if not ok then D.Publish(player, code) end
	end)
end
local function unweld(o)
	if o.weld then o.weld:Destroy(); o.weld = nil end
end
local function resetSample(o)
	o.previousPosition, o.previousVelocity = nil, nil
end
function P.Carry(o, r)
	unweld(o)
	local p = o.package
	p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.Massless = false, false, true
	p.CollisionGroup = "PKCarried"
	p.AssemblyLinearVelocity, p.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
	p.CFrame = r.CFrame * C.CarryOffset
	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Name, weld.Part0, weld.Part1, weld.Parent = "CarryWeld", r, p, p
	o.weld = weld
	resetSample(o)
end
function P.Drop(o, r)
	unweld(o)
	local p = o.package
	p.Anchored, p.Massless, p.CanCollide = false, false, true
	p.CollisionGroup = "PKDropped"
	if r then
		local desired = r.CFrame * C.DropOffset
		-- Jangan menaruh paket di balik dinding ketika dilepas.
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {o.player.Character, W.ActivePackages}
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(r.Position, desired.Position - r.Position, params)
		p.CFrame = hit and CFrame.new(hit.Position - (desired.Position - r.Position).Unit * 2) or desired
	end
	p.AssemblyLinearVelocity, p.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
	p:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
	resetSample(o)
end
function P.Hold(o)
	unweld(o)
	o.package.AssemblyLinearVelocity, o.package.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
	o.package.Anchored = true
	resetSample(o)
end
function P.Recover(o)
	P.Drop(o, nil)
	o.package.CFrame = CFrame.new(W.Map.RecoveryPoint.Position + Vector3.new(0, C.PackageSize.Y / 2 + 0.4, 0))
	resetSample(o)
end
function P.Destroy(o)
	if o.promptConnection then o.promptConnection:Disconnect() end
	unweld(o)
	if o.package then o.package:Destroy() end
end
function P.Start()
	local elapsed = 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		elapsed += dt
		if elapsed < C.PhysicsSampleInterval then return end
		elapsed = 0
		local excluded = {W.ActivePackages}
		for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if player.Character then table.insert(excluded, player.Character) end end
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
		params.RespectCanCollide = true
		for _,o in pairs(D.orders) do
			local p = o.package
			if not p or not p.Parent or o.outOfBounds then continue end
			local pos = p.Position - W.Map.DepotPad.Position
			local lo, hi = C.BoundsMin, C.BoundsMax
			if pos.X < lo.X or pos.Y < lo.Y or pos.Z < lo.Z or pos.X > hi.X or pos.Y > hi.Y or pos.Z > hi.Z then
				D.OutOfBounds(o)
				continue
			end
			local subject, radius = p, p.Size.Y / 2
			if o.status == "Carrying" then
				local char = o.player.Character
				subject = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if subject and hum then radius = hum.HipHeight + subject.Size.Y / 2 end
			end
			if not subject then continue end
			local current, velocity = subject.Position, subject.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			if o.previousPosition and o.previousVelocity then
				local previous = o.previousVelocity
				local speed = o.status == "Carrying" and math.max(0, -previous.Y) or previous.Magnitude
				if speed >= C.ImpactSpeed then
					local delta = current - o.previousPosition
					local hit = delta.Magnitude > 0.01 and workspace:Raycast(o.previousPosition, delta + delta.Unit * (radius + C.ContactMargin), params)
					local direction = o.status == "Carrying" and Vector3.new(0, -1, 0) or previous.Unit
					hit = hit or workspace:Raycast(current, direction * (radius + C.ContactMargin), params)
					if hit and -previous:Dot(hit.Normal) >= C.ImpactSpeed then
						D.Impact(o)
					end
				end
			end
			o.previousPosition, o.previousVelocity = current, velocity
		end
	end)
end
return P

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local PhysicsService = game:GetService("PhysicsService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("PaketKilat")
local C = require(RS.Shared.Config)
local D = require(script.Parent.DeliveryService)
local P = require(script.Parent.PackageService)
local W = workspace:WaitForChild("PaketKilat")
for _,name in ipairs({"PKCharacters", "PKCarried", "PKDropped"}) do
	if not PhysicsService:IsCollisionGroupRegistered(name) then PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup(name) end
end
for _,pair in ipairs({{"PKCharacters", "PKCharacters"}, {"PKCharacters", "PKDropped"}, {"PKCharacters", "PKCarried"}, {"PKCarried", "Default"}, {"PKDropped", "PKDropped"}}) do
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(pair[1], pair[2], false)
end
D.Init(C, P, W, function(player, snapshot, code)
	if player.Parent == Players then RS.Remotes.StateChanged:FireClient(player, snapshot, code) end
end)
P.Init(C, W, D, game:GetService("ServerStorage").PaketKilat.PackageTemplate)
P.Start()
RS.Remotes.ActionRequest.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action, orderId)
	local ok, code = D.Handle(player, action, orderId)
	-- RateLimited tidak menghasilkan reply tak terbatas pada spam.
	if not ok and code ~= "RateLimited" then D.Publish(player, code) end
end)
W.Map.Depot.PickupPoint.StartPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
	local ok, code = D.Handle(player, "Start")
	if not ok then D.Publish(player, code) end
end)
local function setup(player)
	player.RespawnLocation = W.Map.PrototypeSpawn
	local descendantConnection, deathConnection
	local function character(char)
		D.Cancel(player)
		if descendantConnection then descendantConnection:Disconnect() end
		if deathConnection then deathConnection:Disconnect() end
		local function group(v) if v:IsA("BasePart") then v.CollisionGroup = "PKCharacters" end end
		for _,v in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do group(v) end
		descendantConnection = char.DescendantAdded:Connect(group)
		local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
		deathConnection = hum.Died:Connect(function() D.Cancel(player) end)
		char:PivotTo(W.Map.PrototypeSpawn.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
	end
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(character)
	player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
		D.Cancel(player)
		if descendantConnection then descendantConnection:Disconnect() end
		if deathConnection then deathConnection:Disconnect() end
	end)
	if player.Character then task.spawn(character, player.Character) end
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setup)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) D.Cancel(player) end)
for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do setup(player) end
print("[PaketKilat] Bootstrap ready — T01-T06; penyerahan/hadiah belum aktif")
